The 2nd Cohort of Solve Ambassadors: Meet Storm Shield from the U.S.!

Storm Shield is a smart hairband designed to make daily activities safer and more accessible for people who use hearing aids. Using built-in sensors, it detects rain, strong wind, and physical impact, helping users stay aware of their surroundings.

Its waterproof design helps protect hearing aids in various weather conditions, supporting greater freedom of movement.

Storm Shield embodies the Solve For Tomorrow mission: empowering people through thoughtful ideas that aim to create real-world impact.

Watch to see how this Top 10 Global Ambassador solution is making a difference.

 #SolveAmbassador #SolveForTomorrow #TogetherForTomorrow #Samsung
